stem: Mr. Mahbub is the owner of 'Bishwash Company'. He brings mangoes from Rajshahi to Dhaka by truck and stores them initially in a modern warehouse at Karwan Bazar. When mangoes are completely unavailable in the market, he decides to supply the stored mangoes to earn profit.
stem_label: Read the stimulus and answer the following questions

questions.label: a
questions.question: What is utility?

options.A: The ability to produce goods
options.B: The capacity of a commodity to satisfy human wants
options.C: The ability to sell products
options.D: The capacity to store goods

questions.explanation: According to Prof. Mayers, "Utility is the quality or capacity of a goods which enables it to satisfy human wants." In simple terms, utility refers to the want-satisfying power of a commodity.

questions.label: b
questions.question: What type of utility is created by bringing mangoes from Rajshahi to Dhaka? Explain.

options.A: Form utility — because the shape of mangoes has changed
options.B: Time utility — because mangoes reached at a specific time
options.C: Place utility — because goods are transferred from one place to another
options.D: Possession utility — because ownership has changed

questions.explanation: Place utility is created by moving goods from one place to another to satisfy wants. By bringing mangoes from Rajshahi to Dhaka, consumers in distant areas get the opportunity to consume mangoes, which is place utility.

questions.label: c
questions.question: Storage enables consumers to enjoy mangoes for a long time — analyze in light of the stimulus.

options.A: This is form utility — because the quality of mangoes is preserved
options.B: This is time utility — because products of one time are preserved for consumption at another time
options.C: This is place utility — because mangoes are transferred to storage
options.D: This is service utility — because storage is a service

questions.explanation: Time utility means having a product available when you want it. By preserving mangoes in storage and supplying them when mangoes are not available in the market, consumers can enjoy mangoes for a longer period.

questions.label: d
questions.question: What other types of utility are created in the businessman's activities described in the stimulus? Evaluate.

options.A: Only form utility is created
options.B: Only time and place utility are created
options.C: Three types of utility — place, time and possession utility are created
options.D: Only service and information utility are created

questions.explanation: Three types of utility are created: (1) Place utility through transportation from Rajshahi to Dhaka, (2) Time utility through warehousing and storage, (3) Possession utility through the change of ownership when mangoes are bought and sold.

stem: Mr. Iqbal makes bread and sells it in the market. Besides, he produces various vegetables, pulses and corn and supplies them to the market. On the other hand, Mr. Hasan establishes a separate hospital to ensure healthcare services. Free treatment is provided to helpless patients there.
stem_label: Read the stimulus and answer the following questions

questions.label: a
questions.question: What is meant by the agricultural sector of production?

options.A: The sector that uses machinery to produce goods
options.B: The service-oriented sector
options.C: The sector involved in producing agricultural products like rice, wheat, vegetables, fruits etc.
options.D: The sector related to factory production

questions.explanation: Agriculture is the oldest sector of production. The sector involved in producing agricultural products such as rice, wheat, pulses, corn, vegetables, cotton, jute etc. is called the agricultural sector. Fisheries and livestock are sub-sectors of agriculture.

questions.label: b
questions.question: Under which sector of production does Mr. Iqbal's bread-making activity fall? Explain.

options.A: Agricultural sector — because bread is made from wheat
options.B: Service sector — because selling bread is a service
options.C: Industrial sector — because form utility is created from raw materials using technology and machinery
options.D: Commercial sector — because bread is sold in the market

questions.explanation: The sector associated with creating form utility from raw materials and other inputs using technology and machinery is called the industrial sector. Making bread from flour is a processing activity that falls under the industrial sector.

questions.label: c
questions.question: Under which sector does Mr. Hasan's hospital belong? Analyze.

options.A: Industrial sector — because a hospital is an institution
options.B: Agricultural sector — because healthcare is part of agriculture
options.C: Construction sector — because the hospital building was constructed
options.D: Service sector — because it satisfies human needs by providing medical services

questions.explanation: The service sector works to fulfill not only basic needs but also expectations for a comfortable life. A hospital provides medical services to satisfy people's healthcare needs, which falls under the service sector.

questions.label: d
questions.question: Both Mr. Iqbal and Mr. Hasan's activities play important roles in the country's economy — analyze.

options.A: Only Mr. Iqbal's activities contribute to the economy because he produces goods
options.B: Only Mr. Hasan's activities contribute to the economy because he provides free service
options.C: Both activities are important — Iqbal contributes to production and supply of goods, Hasan contributes to human resource development
options.D: Neither activity is important for the economy

questions.explanation: Mr. Iqbal contributes to GDP growth, employment and food supply by producing goods in agriculture and industry. Mr. Hasan's hospital contributes to human resource development and social welfare through healthcare services. Both activities are vital for economic development.

stem: In 2019, the value of products manufactured by 'K Limited' was Tk. 30,00,000. The cost of inputs used by the company was: Raw materials Tk. 5,00,000, Salaries and wages Tk. 2,60,000 and Others Tk. 1,40,000. On the other hand, in 2018, 'Kh Limited' had the same production volume but input costs were: Raw materials Tk. 5,70,000, Salaries Tk. 2,50,000 and Others Tk. 1,80,000.
stem_label: Read the stimulus and answer the following questions

questions.label: a
questions.question: What is productivity?

options.A: The ratio of total production to total GDP
options.B: The ratio of outputs (goods and services) divided by the inputs (resources)
options.C: The ratio of selling price to cost price
options.D: The ratio of total workers to total production

questions.explanation: According to Heizer and Render, "Productivity is the ratio of outputs (goods and services) divided by the inputs (resources)." In simple terms, productivity is the ratio of goods produced to the inputs used in production.

questions.label: b
questions.question: Write the formula for overall productivity.

options.A: Overall productivity = Total input cost / Total output value
options.B: Overall productivity = Total output value × Total input cost
options.C: Overall productivity = Total output value / Total input cost
options.D: Overall productivity = Total input cost — Total output value

questions.explanation: Overall (Total) Productivity = Total Value of Output / Total Value of Input. It is also known as total productivity.

questions.label: c
questions.question: What was the overall productivity of 'K Limited' in 2019?

questions.label: d
questions.question: Based on 2018 and 2019 data, which company is in a more favorable position? Analyze.

options.A: 'Kh Limited' is in a favorable position because their input cost is lower
options.B: 'K Limited' is in a favorable position because their overall productivity (3.33) is higher than 'Kh Limited' (3.00)
options.C: Both companies are in the same favorable position
options.D: Neither is in a favorable position because productivity is below 5

questions.explanation: Overall productivity of 'Kh Limited' = 30,00,000 / (5,70,000 + 2,50,000 + 1,80,000) = 30,00,000 / 10,00,000 = 3.00. Since 'K Limited's productivity (3.33) is higher than 'Kh Limited's (3.00), 'K Limited' is in a more favorable position as it produces the same output with lower input costs.

stem: Bangladesh is lush with greenery. To improve their standard of living and become economically prosperous, the people of this country produce their own necessary raw materials. With this goal, Mr. Foysal established a production-oriented enterprise. Through hard work and proper utilization of factors of production, he also increased the production capacity of the enterprise. As a result, profit increased along with business expansion.
stem_label: Read the stimulus and answer the following questions

questions.label: a
questions.question: According to E. S. Buffa, what is production?

options.A: Production is a process of selling and distributing goods
options.B: Production is a process by which goods and services are created
options.C: Production is only about creating agricultural products
options.D: Production is the process of discovering natural resources

questions.explanation: According to E. S. Buffa, "Production is a process by which goods and services are created."

questions.label: b
questions.question: How can the standard of living be improved? Describe in light of the stimulus.

options.A: By only storing goods
options.B: Without using natural resources
options.C: By creating new goods and services through production, increasing income and consumption levels
options.D: By only increasing import dependency

questions.explanation: Production improves people's standard of living. New products add new dimensions to consumption. When people's income increases, their consumption and lifestyle improve positively. Production also creates employment opportunities.

questions.label: c
questions.question: "To increase production capacity, proper utilization of factors of production must be ensured" — analyze the statement in light of the stimulus.

options.A: Only using capital can increase production capacity
options.B: Proper combination and optimal use of land, labor, capital and organization can increase production capacity
options.C: Only increasing the number of workers can increase production capacity
options.D: Use of factors has no effect on production capacity

questions.explanation: The four main factors of production are land, labor, capital and organization. Proper combination and optimal use of these factors is essential for increasing production capacity. This includes proper planning, hiring skilled workers, using modern machinery and using raw materials correctly.

questions.label: d
questions.question: What steps can be taken to increase the productivity of Mr. Foysal's enterprise? Evaluate.

options.A: Only purchasing machinery can increase productivity
options.B: Only increasing worker salaries can increase productivity
options.C: Efficient management, modern technology, quality raw materials, skilled human resources, good working environment and incentive systems can increase productivity
options.D: No steps are needed to increase productivity

questions.explanation: To increase productivity, the following steps are necessary: efficient management, use of modern technology, quality raw materials, hiring and retaining skilled human resources, maintaining good relations, ensuring good working environment, proper layout, improved production process, research and development, and incentive systems.

stem: Suppose in 2018, the total production of 'Warsi Company' was 50,00,000 carpets. But in 2019, through technological improvement and increasing employee efficiency, the company produced 70,00,000 carpets.
stem_label: Read the stimulus and answer the following questions

questions.label: a
questions.question: According to Norman Gaither and Greg Frazier, what is the definition of productivity?

options.A: Productivity is the amount of products or services produced with the resources used
options.B: Productivity is the amount of sales
options.C: Productivity is the ability to earn profit
options.D: Productivity is the amount of work done by labor

questions.explanation: According to Norman Gaither and Greg Frazier, "Productivity is amount of products or services produced with the resources used."

questions.label: b
questions.question: Explain the reasons for the increase in productivity of 'Warsi Company'.

options.A: Only by reducing the number of employees
options.B: Productivity increased due to technological improvement and increased employee efficiency
options.C: Productivity increased due to increase in product price
options.D: Productivity increased due to change in factory location

questions.explanation: The stimulus states that 'Warsi Company' increased production from 50,00,000 to 70,00,000 carpets through technological improvement and increased employee efficiency. Technology helps increase production and reduce costs. Skilled workers play an important role in increasing productivity.

questions.label: c
questions.question: What are the advantages of increased productivity? Discuss.

options.A: Only product price increases
options.B: Only profit decreases
options.C: More production, higher quality products, reduced production cost, permanent customers and higher profits are possible
options.D: There are no advantages of increased productivity

questions.explanation: The advantages of productivity include: (1) More production, (2) Higher quality products, (3) Reduced production cost, (4) Creating permanent customers, (5) Increasing employee efficiency, (6) Achieving more profit, (7) Using new technology, (8) Achieving economic growth.

questions.label: d
questions.question: Differentiate between production and productivity.

options.A: Production and productivity are the same
options.B: Production creates goods, productivity indicates efficiency; scope of production is broad, scope of productivity is relatively narrow; dynamism is low in production, dynamism is high in productivity
options.C: Productivity creates goods, production indicates efficiency
options.D: There is no difference between production and productivity

questions.explanation: Key differences: Production creates goods, productivity measures input-output ratio. Production creates form utility, productivity does not create any utility. Scope of production is broad, scope of productivity is relatively narrow. Dynamism is low in production, high in productivity. Increased production may not increase productivity, but increased productivity increases production.

stem: Mr. Rafiq is a furniture businessman in Dhaka. He collects quality wood produced in Chattogram and makes various designed furniture. Due to the quality and attractive design of his furniture, he has gained reputation in this business in a short time. Currently, his furniture is being supplied to consumers in different parts of the country. As a result, he is profiting from the business.
stem_label: Read the stimulus and answer the following questions

questions.label: a
questions.question: What is production?

options.A: The process of selling products
options.B: Creating utility and products using natural resources with human knowledge and intelligence
options.C: The process of transporting products
options.D: The process of storing products

questions.explanation: Production is the process of creating utility and products with the help of natural resources using human technical knowledge and intelligence.

questions.label: b
questions.question: Productivity helps increase profit — explain.

options.A: When productivity increases, product quality decreases, so profit increases
options.B: When productivity increases, per-unit production cost decreases, sales and profit increase
options.C: Productivity has no effect on profit
options.D: When productivity decreases, profit increases

questions.explanation: When productivity increases, more products can be produced using the same amount of resources. This reduces per-unit production cost. Due to lower product prices, both sales and profit increase.

questions.label: c
questions.question: What type of utility is created through Mr. Rafiq's primary work? Explain.

options.A: Time utility — because he stores products
options.B: Place utility — because he brings wood to Dhaka
options.C: Form utility — because he changes the form and shape of wood to make furniture
options.D: Service utility — because he serves customers

questions.explanation: Form utility is created through Mr. Rafiq's primary work. Changing the form or shape of natural resources to create usable products creates form utility. Mr. Rafiq collects wood as raw material and changes its form and shape to make furniture.

questions.label: d
questions.question: "Creation of place utility is the main reason for the success of the establishment in the stimulus" — evaluate.

options.A: The statement is wrong, because form utility is the main reason for success
options.B: The statement is correct, because he supplies furniture to different parts of the country, creating customers and increasing sales
options.C: The statement is partially true, because time utility is more important
options.D: The statement is completely wrong, because success does not come only from place utility

questions.explanation: The statement is correct. Place utility is created by transferring products from one place to another. Mr. Rafiq is supplying his furniture to different parts of the country, creating customers outside Dhaka and increasing sales.

stem: Mr. Mina started a business with an investment of Tk 25 lakh at BSCIC in Cumilla. He bought raw materials worth Tk 5 lakh, machinery worth Tk 15 lakh, factory rent Tk 2 lakh and other resources Tk 2 lakh, and produced thread and nets worth Tk 50 lakh. On the other hand, Mr. Hashem invested Tk 30 lakh and bought raw materials worth Tk 10 lakh, machinery worth Tk 15 lakh, factory rent Tk 2 lakh and other resources Tk 2 lakh, and produced products worth Tk 35 lakh.
stem_label: Read the stimulus and answer the following questions

questions.label: a
questions.question: What is organization?

options.A: The process of selling products
options.B: The initiative or effort to proportionally collect, combine and employ land, labor and capital for the purpose of production
options.C: The system of product transportation
options.D: The process of collecting raw materials

questions.explanation: The initiative or effort to proportionally collect, combine and employ land, labor and capital for the purpose of production is called organization.

questions.label: b
questions.question: "Joint venture markets products globally" — explain.

options.A: Joint ventures only sell products in local markets
options.B: Joint ventures formed by combining two or more domestic and foreign companies have more capital and can supply products globally
options.C: Joint ventures have lower profits
options.D: Only domestic companies participate in joint ventures

questions.explanation: When a business is formed by combining two or more domestic and foreign companies, it is called a joint venture. Due to multiple companies, the organization has more capital and can supply products to different parts of the world.

questions.label: c
questions.question: Determine the productivity of Mr. Mina's establishment mentioned in the stimulus.

questions.label: d
questions.question: Considering productivity, which establishment in the stimulus is profitable? Analyze.

options.A: Mr. Hashem's establishment, because his investment is higher
options.B: Mr. Mina's establishment, because his productivity (2.08) is higher than Hashem's (1.21)
options.C: Both establishments are equally profitable
options.D: Neither is profitable

questions.explanation: Mr. Hashem's productivity = 35,00,000/(10,00,000+15,00,000+2,00,000+2,00,000) = 35,00,000/29,00,000 = 1.21. Mr. Mina's productivity (2.08) is higher than Hashem's (1.21), meaning Mina used fewer resources to produce more.

stem: During the production season, onion prices are low, but in the off-season, prices increase abnormally. Considering this, 'Ekta Krishak Samity' collects onions during the production season, preserves them using modern technology, and supplies them to consumers at fair prices in the off-season. The members of the Samity perform all activities themselves, so costs are relatively low. They are quite profitable. The members share profits and losses equally. Through employment, their standard of living is improving.
stem_label: Read the stimulus and answer the following questions

questions.label: a
questions.question: What is production?

options.A: The process of selling products
options.B: The process of changing the form or shape of natural resources to create products usable by humans
options.C: The process of storing products
options.D: The process of importing products

questions.explanation: Production is the process of changing the form or shape of natural resources to create products usable by humans.

questions.label: b
questions.question: "Production creates employment" — explain.

options.A: Production requires few workers
options.B: Employment opportunities are created by hiring workers for production work
options.C: Production reduces employment
options.D: Production has no relation to employment

questions.explanation: Employment opportunities are created by hiring necessary workers for production work. Raw material collection, machine operation, quality control, management — many tasks need to be done continuously, requiring the owner to hire workers.

questions.label: c
questions.question: What type of utility is 'Ekta Krishak Samity' creating first in the stimulus? Explain.

options.A: Form utility — because they process onions
options.B: Place utility — because they transport onions
options.C: Time utility — because they preserve products from one time for another time
options.D: Possession utility — because they sell onions

questions.explanation: 'Ekta Krishak Samity' is first creating time utility. When products from one time are preserved for consumption at another time to satisfy human wants, time utility is created. The Samity collects onions during the production season, preserves them, and supplies them in the off-season.

questions.label: d
questions.question: Evaluate the contribution of 'Ekta Krishak Samity' in improving members' standard of living.

options.A: The Samity has no contribution
options.B: The Samity only plays a role in onion preservation
options.C: Members doing all work themselves and sharing profits has improved employment, income, and standard of living
options.D: Reducing onion prices is the Samity's only contribution

questions.explanation: Through onion collection, preservation, and selling, employment opportunities are created for Samity members. Members do all work themselves, sell onions at fair prices, and share profits equally. This solves unemployment and increases income.

stem: In 2019, Style Zone Ltd.'s produced product value was Tk 10,00,000. The cost of resources used was: raw materials Tk 4,00,000, salaries and wages Tk 2,00,000, and others Tk 1,00,000. In 2018, with the same production quantity, resource costs were: raw materials Tk 4,50,000, salaries and wages Tk 2,00,000, and others Tk 1,50,000.
stem_label: Read the stimulus and answer the following questions

questions.label: a
questions.question: What is utility?

options.A: The ability to produce products
options.B: The capacity of a product or service to satisfy human wants
options.C: The ability to sell products
options.D: The ability to store products

questions.explanation: The capacity of a product or service to satisfy human wants is called utility.

questions.label: b
questions.question: How is material productivity determined through formula?

options.A: Value of materials / Total value of output
options.B: Total value of output / Value of materials
options.C: Quantity of materials × Total production
options.D: Total production / Quantity of materials

questions.explanation: Material productivity = Total value of output / Value of materials used. It is the ratio of total output value to the value of raw materials used in production.

questions.label: c
questions.question: Determine the overall productivity of Style Zone Ltd. for 2019.

questions.label: d
questions.question: Evaluate the overall production situation of the establishment for 2018 in light of the stimulus.

options.A: 2018 was better because production was higher
options.B: 2018 productivity (1.25) was lower than 2019 (1.43), so the establishment was more efficient in 2019
options.C: Both years were equal
options.D: No production occurred in 2018

questions.explanation: 2018 overall productivity = 10,00,000/(4,50,000+2,00,000+1,50,000) = 10,00,000/8,00,000 = 1.25. 2019 productivity (1.43) is higher than 2018 (1.25), indicating more efficient resource utilization.
